description: This file contains implementation of a PWM testing tool for rusEfi firmware, including functions to initialize PWM tests, schedule signal outputs, and manage test sequences, primarily used for measuring PWM generation quality.

classes.name: LoggingWithStorage
classes.description: Logger object used for logging within PWM tests.

classes.name: SimplePwm
classes.description: Struct representing a PWM instance used in the test.

classes.name: OutputPin
classes.description: Represents a hardware output pin used in PWM testing.

methods.name: startPwmTest
methods.description: Initializes and starts PWM signals for testing at a specified frequency.

methods.name: testCallback
methods.description: Callback function to schedule a series of output signals for PWM testing.

methods.name: initPwmTester
methods.description: Sets up the PWM tester, including initializing logging, starting PWM signals, and scheduling test routines.
